---
title: "Genetic Risk Score Analysis Report"
output: html_document
params:
  grs_table: NA
  pheno_table: NA
  prefix: NA
  quantiles: "all"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)

install_if_needed <- function(pkg) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg, repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
  }
}

install_if_needed("ggplot2")
install_if_needed("dplyr")
install_if_needed("tidyr")

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

# Load Data

```{r load}
grs <- read.csv(params$grs_table)
pheno <- read.csv(params$pheno_table)

dat <- merge(grs, pheno, by="IID")

grs_vars <- grep("^GRS", colnames(dat), value=TRUE)
pheno_vars <- setdiff(colnames(pheno), "IID")
```

# Quantile Construction

```{r make-quantiles}
q_option <- tolower(params$quantiles)

all_types <- c("terciles","quartiles","quintiles","deciles","all")

chosen <- if (q_option == "all") {
  c("terciles","quartiles","quintiles","deciles","deciles10")
} else {
  unlist(strsplit(q_option, ","))
}

make_split <- function(vec, n, name) {
  nt <- ntile(vec, n)
  return(nt)
}

for (g in grs_vars) {
  vec <- dat[[g]]

  if ("terciles" %in% chosen) {
    dat[[paste0(g,"_tercile")]] <- make_split(vec, 3)
  }

  if ("quartiles" %in% chosen) {
    dat[[paste0(g,"_quartile")]] <- make_split(vec, 4)
  }

  if ("quintiles" %in% chosen) {
    dat[[paste0(g,"_quintile")]] <- make_split(vec, 5)
  }

  if ("deciles" %in% chosen) {
    dat[[paste0(g,"_decile")]] <- make_split(vec, 10)
  }
}
```

# Scatterplots by Chosen Quantiles

```{r plots}
for (g in grs_vars) {
  for (ph in pheno_vars) {

    if ("terciles" %in% chosen) {
      p <- ggplot(dat, aes_string(x=g, y=ph)) +
        geom_point() +
        facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", paste0(g,"_tercile")))) +
        ggtitle(paste(g, "vs", ph, "by terciles"))
      print(p)
    }

    if ("quartiles" %in% chosen) {
      p <- ggplot(dat, aes_string(x=g, y=ph)) +
        geom_point() +
        facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", paste0(g,"_quartile")))) +
        ggtitle(paste(g, "vs", ph, "by quartiles"))
      print(p)
    }

    if ("quintiles" %in% chosen) {
      p <- ggplot(dat, aes_string(x=g, y=ph)) +
        geom_point() +
        facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", paste0(g,"_quintile")))) +
        ggtitle(paste(g, "vs", ph, "by quintiles"))
      print(p)
    }

    if ("deciles" %in% chosen) {
      p <- ggplot(dat, aes_string(x=g, y=ph)) +
        geom_point() +
        facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", paste0(g,"_decile")))) +
        ggtitle(paste(g, "vs", ph, "by deciles"))
      print(p)
    }
  }
}
```

# Boxplots Across All Phenotypes

```{r boxplots}
for (g in grs_vars) {

  if ("terciles" %in% chosen) {
    p <- ggplot(dat, aes_string(x=paste0(g,"_tercile"), y=g)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle(paste("Boxplot of", g, "by terciles"))
    print(p)
  }

  if ("quartiles" %in% chosen) {
    p <- ggplot(dat, aes_string(x=paste0(g,"_quartile"), y=g)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle(paste("Boxplot of", g, "by quartiles"))
    print(p)
  }

  if ("quintiles" %in% chosen) {
    p <- ggplot(dat, aes_string(x=paste0(g,"_quintile"), y=g)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle(paste("Boxplot of", g, "by quintiles"))
    print(p)
  }

  if ("deciles" %in%colnames(dat)) {
    p <- ggplot(dat, aes_string(x=paste0(g,"_decile"), y=g)) +
      geom_boxplot() +
      ggtitle(paste("Boxplot of", g, "by deciles"))
    print(p)
  }
}
```

# Decile Trend Analysis

```{r trend}
for (g in grs_vars) {

  if ("deciles" %in% chosen) {
    trend <- dat %>%
      group_by(.data[[paste0(g,"_decile")]]) %>%
      summarise(mean_ph = mean(.data[[pheno_vars[1]]], na.rm=TRUE))

    p <- ggplot(trend, aes_string(x=names(trend)[1], y="mean_ph")) +
      geom_line() +
      ggtitle(paste("Trend across deciles for", g))

    print(p)
  }
}
```
